what_happened: Discovered that check-module-invariants.sh's C16 blocks (both the FormalSystem-only half and the all-roots half) are RUN_BUILD-gated and CI invokes the script with --no-build, so flipping ENFORCE_C16_ROOTS=1 affects only the local full-mode gate, not CI; FormalSystem's own C16 enforcement in CI actually comes from the separate lean-action lint:true step via lake lint/nolints.json. Recorded as a risk/decision point in the research report so the plan phase does not assume local enforcement implies CI enforcement.

Confirmed via the vendored Batteries runLinter.lean source that scripts/nolints.json is read unconditionally at a fixed relative path regardless of which module is passed to runLinter, meaning the C16-roots baseline can reuse the existing nolints.json grandfathering mechanism directly (extend it with the other 16 dirty roots' findings, then flip ENFORCE_C16_ROOTS) rather than inventing a parallel per-root baseline file.

Dispatch description's 62 STALE DATE figure is the default-root (FormalSystem-only) measurement; CI invokes readme-lint.sh with 'FormalSystem BimodalTools', which measures 63 stale / 86 READMEs. Not a drift in the signal, a scope mismatch in the carried figure. Plan now requires a path-keyed baseline so one committed file serves every root subset, and records both measurements.

All five cheap-to-verify dispatch figures (62/4/84 READMEs; C20's 10, 145-of-1030, 39, 30) re-confirmed live this dispatch rather than carried: readme-lint.sh took seconds and check-module-invariants.sh --no-build ran detached while the plan was authored, exiting 0. The 18-root C16 denominator was independently re-derived from scripts/lake_targets.py. Only the 231/16 numerator remains carried, and Phase 3 measures it as its first task.

Phase 1 closing commit fired before the progressive phase-end handoff was written (handoff written just after, not staged into that commit). Left uncommitted to ride into Phase 2's phase-closing commit per the task-directory pathspec, rather than issuing a separate provenance-only commit, which is prohibited.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'scripts/c16-roots-unmeasurable.txt' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #938's declared file_scope.

Phase 3's commit omitted scripts/c16-roots-unmeasurable.txt because it was never listed in any objective's files_touched, so git-commit-phase.sh never attempted to stage it. Fixed with a scoped follow-up commit; the file was additionally outside the task's declared file_scope, requiring a one-line file_scope widening in specs/state.json first (git-commit-scoped.sh's own containment guard refuses an out-of-scope path with no proposed_file_scope deposit, unlike git-commit-phase.sh's patched Containment Self-Check). A naive python json.dump(..., indent=2) re-serialization of state.json for that widening initially corrupted the whole file by re-escaping every non-ASCII character via ensure_ascii's default True; caught before committing and redone with ensure_ascii=False, producing a clean one-line diff.

Phase 5's own prose in docs/development/MODULE_INVARIANTS.md, describing the C20 residual falsification seeds verbatim, accidentally wrote the literal citation shapes 'FormalSystem/Syntax/Formula.lean:5' and 'NoSuchFileAtAll.lean:5' -- which C20's own tier-2/residual-ceiling assertions then detected as new publication-facing file.lean:NNN citations in docs/, since docs/ is itself in C20's scanned scope. Caught by re-running check-module-invariants.sh --no-build (FAIL C20 tier 2 + residual ceiling) before committing; fixed by rephrasing both ('Formula.lean, line 5' instead of 'Formula.lean:5'). Lesson: describing a C20 falsification seed in prose anywhere under docs/ must avoid reproducing the exact file.lean:NNN shape, or the description becomes a second, real citation.
